def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    def rot(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    a = grid
    b = rot(a)
    c = rot(b)
    d = rot(c)
    return [a[i] + b[i] for i in range(n)] + [d[i] + c[i] for i in range(n)]
